Anthropic 今天再次修订了其 S-1。
第 2 号修订

inlines.text:
Anthropic 今天再次修订了其 S-1。
第 2 号修订

blocks.text: 在今天的文件中，Anthropic 表示它已越过其《负责任扩展政策》中设定的一条红线：即 AI 使 AI 研究大幅加速的节点，这要求更严格的安全检查。

inlines.text: 在今天的文件中，Anthropic 表示它已越过其《负责任扩展政策》中设定的一条红线：即 AI 使 AI 研究大幅加速的节点，这要求更严格的安全检查。

blocks.text: 一周前，它只是表示自己“可能即将”越过这条线。这一判断基于它对未来模型的预期，而非当前模型已展现出的任何表现。该文件还将 IPO 价格定为每股 70 至 78 美元。

blocks.text:
Anthropic again amended its S-1 today. 
Amendment No. 2

inlines.text:
Anthropic again amended its S-1 today. 
Amendment No. 2

blocks.text: In its today's filing, Anthropic says it has crossed a line set in its Responsible Scaling Policy: the point where AI is making AI research much faster, which requires stronger safety checks.

inlines.text: In its today's filing, Anthropic says it has crossed a line set in its Responsible Scaling Policy: the point where AI is making AI research much faster, which requires stronger safety checks.

blocks.text: A week earlier it said only that it “may imminently” cross it. The call is based on what it expects from future models, not on anything current models have shown. The filing also sets the IPO price at $70 to $78 a share.
